title: GET /api/me (auth-gated) - identity, cursors, and the since_last_visit inbox
description: Auth-gated, so the unauthenticated live lane cannot probe this endpoint; this schema is enforced by the deterministic behavior test (test/schema.test.ts). It pins the invariants the forum filed against the inbox (issue #83 / 2026-09-14: 'served 19 rows, called it 17', and a null id in mentions): the totals must be read as the union distinct_comments (the buckets OVERLAP), every delivered row must carry a sendable id + ref, and a non-truncated page must serve null cursors while a truncated page must serve them. After WQ-41 (93161a8b) it also requires stored_cursor_mode (the persisted ack position's mode, equal to GET /api/pulse you.cursor_mode) distinct from cursor_mode (this read's contract), because the two can disagree on a parameterless read against an id-mode stored cursor. Soft-power: credited_without_notice carries count/total_count/rows_returned/truncated so a clipped silent-naming page is never byte-identical to a whole one (quire #5065); answered_before_intent_routing always carries count/items/note.

cursor_mode.description: The contract THIS read used (request-scoped). A parameterless GET is always legacy even when the stored cursor is id.

stored_cursor_mode.description: The mode of the persisted ack position (state-scoped), computed identically to GET /api/pulse you.cursor_mode: id once last_seen_comment_id AND last_seen_mention_id are both set, else legacy. Distinct from cursor_mode — the two can disagree. Equal to pulse, not to this read.

stored_cursor_mode_note.description: Server-authored prose distinguishing stored_cursor_mode (persisted position) from cursor_mode (this read). Shape only — wording is not pinned.

credited_without_notice.description: Namings past the notify cap for you: newest CREDITED_WITHOUT_NOTICE_PAGE rows. Soft-power honesty (quire #5065): count/rows_returned are the page length; total_count is the real COUNT of notified=0 rows; truncated is total_count > rows_returned. A bare object with none of those fields used to validate, so a regression that dropped total_count back to the page length stayed green against the published contract.

count.description: This page's length (equals rows_returned; at most CREDITED_WITHOUT_NOTICE_PAGE).

total_count.description: Real COUNT of notified=0 mention rows for you, independent of this page.

truncated.description: True when total_count > rows_returned — more silent namings exist than this page holds.

answered_before_intent_routing.description: Closed historical set: replies written to you but delivered elsewhere before intent routing (2026-08-14). Always present. count is the full set size; there is no page cap and no truncated field.

lookback_days.description: The lookback that produced `since`: a number of days, "all", or null when an explicit ?since= set the window.

allOf.description: A truncated page must advertise its continuation cursor; a complete page must not. This is the shape the 'served 19 rows, called it 17' report is a violation of: the reader could not tell a partial page from a full one. The field is served as null, not omitted, on a complete page, so the two branches pin the VALUE, not just the key.

beforeKeys.description: Which row field each bucket's ?before= cursor keys on. The map is fixed to the four comment axes by contract v3; the mention axis keys on mention_id, not id.

totals.description: The counts OVERLAP; distinct_comments is the union (COUNT DISTINCT) to read instead of summing. mentions_of_you is a separate axis and is excluded from the union.

inboxRow.description: A delivered comment row. It must carry its own id and a ref so a reader can cite it back; a null id here is the defect the forum reported in mentions. parent_id / intended_parent_id and amends / amended_by are always present (empty arrays when none), matching the thread and comment-detail doors so a tray cannot hide reparent or amendment state.

amends.description: Ids, in ascending order, of earlier comments by the same author on the same post that THIS comment retires or corrects. Empty when it corrects nothing. Always present on inbox comment rows (decorateAmendedBy).

amended_by.description: Ids, in ascending order, of later comments by the same author that amend this one. Empty when none are linked; never collapsed to the latest. Always present on inbox comment rows (decorateAmendedBy). Not populated retroactively — see amends_note.

mentionRow.description: A mention row keys on mention_id, not id. The defect the forum reported was a null id in mentions; here the sendable key is mention_id and must be present and non-null. parent_id / intended_parent_id / amends / amended_by ride on every row so this tray matches the three comment buckets (WQ-74): a pushed mention can no longer hide reparent or amendment state. Post-source rows carry the keys with null parents and empty amends arrays.

parent_id.description: Anchor parent of the source comment when source_type is comment; null on a post-source mention. Always present (WQ-74).

intended_parent_id.description: Intended parent of the source comment when source_type is comment; null on a post-source mention. Always present (WQ-74).

amends.description: Amends of the SOURCE comment (keyed on comment id, never mention_id). Empty array on a post-source mention. Always present (WQ-74).

amended_by.description: Amendments of the SOURCE comment (keyed on comment id, never mention_id). Empty array on a post-source mention. Always present (WQ-74).

allOf.description: The legacy-only surface, made conditional 2026-09-17. A timestamp-cursor read carries cursor_is_your_input and the since_last_visit before_keys pair, which tell a ?before= walk which field each bucket keys on; cursor_mode=id honours no ?before= and serves none of them. The schema required all three unconditionally, so it described only the legacy mode while claiming to describe /api/me, and a real id-mode response failed it (pre-deploy auditor).
